name: ac-securities-litigation
description: Handling securities litigation as a holder and as an analyst: class action mechanics and the claims process, settlement funds and the decision to opt out, damages estimation and the methods behind it, litigation funding and its economics, D&O cover and indemnification, policy aggregate limits and their exhaustion, regulatory enforcement alongside private claims, and the written litigation record. It explains the process and the arithmetic; it is not legal advice and never predicts an outcome. Use when asking "securities class action", "claim form", "opt out", "settlement fund", "damages estimate", "litigation funding", "D and O cover", "will I get a recovery", "lead plaintiff". Not for the company's credit or equity case (ac-equity-research), not for contract and policy interpretation in general (ac-insurance-and-risk-transfer), not for regulatory compliance programme design (ac-security-standards).
